text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was downgrading Brazilian food processor Perdigao to hold from buy.
-- "Net income of only 9.8 million reais highlights the market difficulties in 1996," it said in a report.
-- "As the 1996 profit was slightly below our expectations and due to the higher multiples, we are changing our buy recommendation to hold," it added.
-- Fator Securities said higher costs and fierce competition squeezed margins with the gross margin falling to 24.7 percent from 25.1 percent, and net margin to 1.9 percent from 4.1 percent in 1995.
-- Perdigao preferred shares were up 2.08 percent at 2.35 reais in afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bourse. Its common stock was flat at 2.00 reais.
